task_name: World 104 Task A  -  Post-Close QBO Reclass vs. Excel Model & CFO Board Deck Drift
prompt: Audit CortexMed Surgical Systems' post-close QBO Trial Balance against the draft Excel financial model tabs (`cortexmed_gl_vs_excel_model_2026_09.xlsx`) and Slide 4 of the executive PowerPoint board deck (`cfo_board_deck_slide4_extract.txt`). Identify every figure in the Excel model and Slide 4 that drifted after the post-close adjusting journal entries, and compute the exact corrected figures.

rubric.description: Identifies AJE-11 as a $42,600.00 reclassification of clinical contractor spend from 6400 G&A Professional Fees to 5300 Clinical COGS, increasing Clinical COGS from $304,800.00 to $347,400.00.
Computes audited Gross Profit as $552,600.00 (61.40% Gross Margin) versus the stale $595,200.00 (66.13% Gross Margin) shown in Excel cell G14/G15 and Slide 4 (-$42,600.00 / -473 bps drift).
Identifies AJE-12 as capitalizing $15,000.00 of surgical jig tooling from 6450 R&D Supplies ($96,800.00 -> $81,800.00) to 1520 Fixed Assets.
Computes audited Adjusted EBITDA as $184,200.00 (20.47% EBITDA margin) versus the stale $169,200.00 shown in Excel cell G28 and Slide 4 (+$15,000.00 drift).

Explains why AJE-11 ($42,600.00 G&A to COGS) reduces Gross Profit by $42,600.00 but has $0.00 net impact on Adjusted EBITDA, whereas AJE-12 ($15,000.00 R&D Expense to CapEx) increases Adjusted EBITDA by $15,000.00.

Flags Slide 4 of `cfo_board_deck_slide4_extract.txt` as blocked from release until Gross Profit ($552,600.00), Gross Margin (61.40%), and Adjusted EBITDA ($184,200.00) are synchronized with the post-close QBO ledger.
Reports post-close 6400 G&A Professional Fees as $106,000.00 and 6450 R&D Supplies as $81,800.00.
Reports total post-close Operating Expenses (6400 G&A $106,000.00 + 6450 R&D $81,800.00 + Other OpEx $180,600.00) as $368,400.00.

gold_output:
World 104 Task A  -  Post-Close QBO Reclass vs. Excel Model & CFO Board Deck Sync Audit:
1. AJE-11 Clinical COGS Reclass: Reclassifies $42,600.00 of clinical contractor spend from 6400 G&A Professional Fees ($148,600.00 -> $106,000.00) to 5300 Clinical COGS ($304,800.00 -> $347,400.00). Audited Gross Profit is $552,600.00 (61.40% Gross Margin) versus the stale $595,200.00 (66.13% Gross Margin) in Excel cell G14/G15 and Slide 4 (-473 bps drift).
2. AJE-12 Surgical Tooling Capitalization: Capitalizes $15,000.00 from 6450 R&D Supplies ($96,800.00 -> $81,800.00) to 1520 Fixed Assets. Total post-close Operating Expenses are $368,400.00 ($106,000.00 G&A + $81,800.00 R&D + $180,600.00 Other OpEx).
3. Adjusted EBITDA Impact: AJE-11 ($42,600.00 G&A to COGS) reduces Gross Profit by $42,600.00 but has $0.00 net impact on Adjusted EBITDA, whereas AJE-12 ($15,000.00 R&D Expense to CapEx) increases Adjusted EBITDA by $15,000.00 from $169,200.00 to $184,200.00 (20.47% EBITDA margin across Excel cell G28 and Slide 4).
4. Release Gate Block: Slide 4 of `cfo_board_deck_slide4_extract.txt` and the Excel `P&L_Summary` tab are blocked from release until Gross Profit ($552,600.00), Gross Margin (61.40%), and Adjusted EBITDA ($184,200.00) are synchronized with the post-close QBO ledger.
